svg.title: Less time making every picture.
svg.desc: A native macOS desktop and Keynote window accompany the Mac encoder measurements from the release notes. Encoding was about thirty milliseconds and is now about ten to twelve milliseconds in the two-screen 2560 by 1440, 100 Mbit per second test. The motion is illustrative and does not measure end-to-end latency.
svg.text: A quicker picture when your Mac shares a screen or lends an extended monitor.
On by default on Mac. Turn it off to favour fine text; restart Sysvia to apply.
Measured encode time from the release notes. Animation is illustrative, not a latency test.
